note: Lincoln County campground (USACE-built) on Clarks Hill/J. Strom Thurmond Lake where the Broad River meets the Savannah, run by the Georgia Freshwater Campgrounds concessionaire. Boat ramp, fish cleaning station. --Claude
summary: Read the concessionaire's page and Lincoln County's parks page. Confirmed 31 sites (7 double, 2 triple) all water/electric, dump, booking online (Firefly); added showers, booking platform/url. Electric amperage and the rate are only on the Firefly engine (reCAPTCHA, not automated), so fees and amps stay unset. Note cleaned (dropped the dated Helene line and field facts).
flags: Rate and amperage need a saved Firefly page: https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/GeorgiaFreshwaterCampgrounds (the sibling Clay Hill 14379 was priced from an AWH-saved page: $35 W/E). Neither the concessionaire's page nor the county page posts a fee.
Phone: county lists the campground at (706) 359-2053 (stored); the concessionaire's contact is 800-405-1033.
Website: second line https://www.gafreshwatercamping.com/broad-river-site is the operator's page (live); first line (county) is a general Lincoln County recreation page, fine as a secondary.
